## Leidos Schedules Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call for November 3, 2026, at 8 a.m. (ET)


October 6, 2026


[PDF Version](https://investors.leidos.com/node/36231/pdf)


RESTON, Va.


, Oct. 6, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Leidos (NYSE: LDOS) today announced it has scheduled a conference call for Tuesday, November 3, 2026, at 8 a.m. (ET) to announce its third quarter 2026 financial results for the period ending October 2, 2026, with the company planning to issue its quarterly earnings press release before the call.


The details for the earnings conference call follow:


**Date:**


November 3, 2026


**Time:**


8 a.m. (ET)


The company offers a live and replay audio broadcast of the conference call with corresponding press release, presentation materials, and supplemental information at[http://ir.leidos.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4789827-1&h=2204154661&u=http%3A%2F%2Fir.leidos.com%2F&a=http%3A%2F%2Fir.leidos.com) . To listen via telephone, please[follow this link.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4789827-1&h=2619424252&u=https%3A%2F%2Fregister-conf.media-server.com%2Fregister%2FBI21acde195b7b4037be97de3ea25f78b3&a=follow+this+link.)


An archived version of the webcast will be available on the Leidos Investor Relations website at[http://ir.leidos.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4789827-1&h=2204154661&u=http%3A%2F%2Fir.leidos.com%2F&a=http%3A%2F%2Fir.leidos.com) until November 3, 2027.


**About Leidos:**


Leidos is an industry and technology leader serving government and commercial customers with smarter, more efficient digital and mission innovations. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, with approximately 50,000 global employees, Leidos reported annual revenues of approximately $17.2 billion for the fiscal year ended January 2, 2026. For more information, visit[www.leidos.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4789827-1&h=2392193532&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.leidos.com%2F&a=www.leidos.com) .
